text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide ran a great race in the 
Tenno Sho (Spring). Yet the public still 
only sees her as "Narita Brian's older 
sister."

Had the venue not been changed, the 
precision of the "equation" would have 
been higher, and we could have shown an 
even stronger Biwa Hayahide—

Biwa Hayahide tells her disappointed 
Trainer that changing the course couldn't 
be helped. She was already firing herself 
up for what lies ahead.

Her goal: the Takarazuka Kinen, where the 
chosen Umamusume gather. To show off her 
best running there, she decided to make 
preparations together with Biwa Hayahide.
